_meta.purpose: Baseline control universe for --compliance 800-53. Checked-in extract of the DISTINCT base NIST 800-53 Rev5 controls named in infrabot's CMMC-L2 authority (cmmc_level2_aws.json, 110 requirements). Used only to count/name controls NOT assessable from IaC (SPEC 7.2). NOT a runtime-derived or invented set.
_meta.source: infrabot src/compliance/cmmc_level2_aws.json (CMMC Level 2 / NIST 800-171 Rev2 -> 800-53 Rev5)
_meta.note: baseControls are family+number only (enhancements collapsed); a control is 'assessable from IaC' iff >=1 Checkov rule in control-map.json maps to it.
